newsitem.title: USA: United Dental to buy three companies.
newsitem.headline: United Dental to buy three companies.

text.p: United Dental Care Inc said on Tuesday it had signed separate definitive stock purchase agreements to buy three dental benefit companies.
The first company, United Dental Care Inc, an unrelated company based in Oklahoma City, operates managed dental benefit plans in Oklahoma, providing benefits to over 90,000 members.

The second, International Dental Plans Inc, based in southern Florida, provides managed dental benefits to over 100,000 members in the state. The completion of these transactions is contingent upon certain conditions including approvals from the respective Oklahoma and Florida insurance departments.
UDC also has agreed to acquire Association Dental Plan Inc, which has more than 60,000 members nationwide.
